name: read-disappearance
objective: Repair filesystem read error normalization when an observed file disappears during inspection/stat or byte loading, or becomes a directory before byte loading. Preserve documented FilesystemNotFoundError/NotAFileError boundaries, actual underlying cause and useful path. Preserve normal decoding, explicit/inferred formats, size limits, permission errors and stable missing/directory behavior. Only reading.py may be edited; do not change tests or acceptance.
